_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} na mokili ya LinesOfAction.
Bipayi na yo bazali '{side}', bipayi ya mokonzi bazali '{other}'.
Format ya mouvement : `[b1b3]` (coord-from coord-to). Mouvement ya ligi aza na mbala ya miraba sawa na bipayi zote (mokili yoyi) na ligi wana. Ozali koluka bipayi na yo, kasi si bipayi ya mokonzi ; kutua na bipayi ya mokonzi ekoma.  Ozwi lobi bipayi zote zinaunganishwa na 8-makonzi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formati ezali na lokota e2e4 (lokasi ya kwanza, lokasi ya suka).
invalid_move.identical: Ebandeli mpe esika oyo bazali kokende ezali ndenge moko.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Esengeli kotambola semba to na ekulusu.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Esengeli kotambola na ntaka ekokani na biteni oyo ezali molɔngɔ́ moko.
invalid_move.destination_own: Esika oyo moto moko azali kokende.

game_action.captured_suffix: Mokonzi {player_id} akomaki {from} -> {to} akolonga mosusu wa nsɛ́.

outcome.draw_repetition: Na nsima, bózongela esika yango mbala misato.
